entries.description: Drafted E5-bis's three slots (classification route, 2 sessions, classification-or-halt) and the ternary framing. TERMINATION POINT WAS HUMAN RATIFICATION on reading it, plus two amendments that sharpened the deliverable. Logged actor=ai because the direction content was AI-authored; the chain terminated at a human, which is exactly the structure the refined E1 claim predicts.

Read log's totalization convention as possible instrument-relativity rather than as mathematics, and reframed the classification question from binary (sixth class vs ceiling) to ternary. No error existed in the analysis as given. The reframing is what made session 1 discriminating rather than exploratory.

PREVENTIVE: first use of the new note convention, applied to its own occasion. Appended three theorems after 'end Certcom' so the names were out of scope — caught by the build. CORRECTIVE, not preventive; the preventive one was declining to start phase 26, logged unmarked on 2026-07-30 because the convention did not exist yet.

findings.description: The degenerate cells measure the junk branch of a totalized log, not Hardy-field asymptotics — and produce 1/x, the function the programme excludes. Marked BLOCKED-BY-CONVENTION, not closed.

EMLTreeValid.divisor_pos: a valid tree's divisor is strictly positive with margin, so the artifact has no valid-tree instance and the tree-level 1/x notin EML claim is unaffected. The safety pre-existed in a predicate written for numerical reasons; what was missing was the theorem saying so.
